scope: Fresh independent-source and live-row recheck of the proposed 108:1 Qurtubi Meccan-clause name correction. Does not apply the proposed English edit or clear any hold.

arabic.exact_clause: وهي مكية في قول ابن عباس والكلبي ومقاتل

english.old_phrase: It is Meccan according to Ibn Abbas, al-Kalbi, and Mujahid.
english.proposed_phrase: It is Meccan according to Ibn Abbas, al-Kalbi, and Muqatil.

witnesses.locator: al-Qurṭubī, al-Jāmiʿ li-aḥkām al-Qurʾān, Sūrah 108:1; volume 20, printed p. 192; opening chapter statement
digital p. 7405; volume 20, printed p. 216; Sūrah 108 introduction

finding: These witnesses support Muqatil in the Meccan clause and place Mujahid in the separate Medinan clause in editions that include it. The live Arabic row omits that Medinan clause, so this recheck supports only the proposed narrow name substitution in the English witness; it does not authorize importing the omitted clause or establishing the historical correctness of either attribution.
next_step: Resolve PR branch freshness against current main before any merge consideration; keep the textual proposal distinct from scholarly approval and live publication.
